purpose: 执行前保存实际5官网原全文GET完整程序，失败目标不重试
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor,as_completed
import json,hashlib,requests
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
ROOT=Path.cwd()
R='reports/research/510300_industrial_multidimensional_cash_constraint_source_v1'
OUT=ROOT/R;SD=OUT/'sources';SD.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
targets=[
{'key':'2018Y','role':'旧应收及主营分母的当季原定义','url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/xxgk/sjfb/zxfb2020/201901/t20190128_1768279.html'},
{'key':'2019Q1Q3','role':'2019实际应收票据范围及营业收入调整原说明','url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/xxgk/sjfb/zxfb2020/201910/t20191027_1768134.html'},
{'key':'2021M07','role':'中期同原企业财务数量向量及实际应收定义','url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/xxgk/sjfb/zxfb2020/202108/t20210827_1821188.html'},
{'key':'2024M11','role':'近期同原企业财务数量向量及当前公式','url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/xxgk/sjfb/zxfb2020/202412/t20241227_1957913.html'},
{'key':'industrial_FAQ','role':'统计局原方法及实际旧发布链接','url':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/hd/cjwtjd/202302/t20230207_1902277.html'}
]
assert len(targets)<=12 and len({t['url'] for t in targets})==len(targets)
ledger=OUT/'实际首批5原GET调用账本.jsonl';assert not ledger.exists()
record=OUT/'原首批5目标实际登记.json';assert not record.exists()
record.write_text(json.dumps({'at':now(),'targets':targets,'failed_2024Y_web_target_not_retried':'https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/zxfb/202501/t20250127_1958485.html','retries':0,'source_only':True},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
def get(t):
 start=now()
 try:
  resp=requests.get(t['url'],timeout=30,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0'})
  b=resp.content
  path=SD/(t['key']+'.html');assert not path.exists()
  path.write_bytes(b)
  enc=resp.encoding if resp.encoding and resp.encoding.lower() not in ['iso-8859-1','latin-1'] else 'utf-8'
  tx=b.decode(enc,errors='replace')
  soup=BeautifulSoup(tx,'html.parser')
  parsed=soup.get_text('\n',strip=True)
  textp=SD/(t['key']+'_全文.txt');assert not textp.exists();textp.write_text(parsed,encoding='utf-8')
  title=soup.title.get_text(' ',strip=True) if soup.title else 'UNKNOWN'
  meta=[{'name':m.get('name') or m.get('property'),'content':m.get('content')} for m in soup.select('meta[name],meta[property]')]
  return {**t,'started_at':start,'received_at':now(),'status_code':resp.status_code,'final_url':resp.url,
    'bytes':len(b),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest(),'html_path':str(path.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'),
    'text_path':str(textp.relative_to(ROOT)).replace('\\','/'),'title':title,'metadata':meta,
    'expected_content_seen':bool(('应收' in parsed and '工业企业' in parsed) or (t['key']=='industrial_FAQ' and '主营业务收入' in parsed)),
    'public_authentication_used':False,'retries':0,'original_binary_edited':False,'full_text':parsed}
 except Exception as e:
  return {**t,'started_at':start,'received_at':now(),'status':'ONE_ORIGINAL_GET_FAILED_NOT_RETRIED','error':type(e).__name__+':'+str(e),'retries':0}
results=[]
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=3) as pool:
 futures={pool.submit(get,t):t for t in targets}
 for fut in as_completed(futures):
  r=fut.result();results.append(r)
  with ledger.open('a',encoding='utf-8') as f:f.write(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in r.items() if k!='full_text'},ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps({'原目标':r['key'],'HTTP':r.get('status_code',r.get('status')),'实际原文':r.get('expected_content_seen',False)},ensure_ascii=False),flush=True)
results.sort(key=lambda r:next(i for i,t in enumerate(targets) if t['key']==r['key']))
p=OUT/'原首批5当前原全文与取得回执.json';assert not p.exists()
p.write_text(json.dumps({'at':now(),'actual_distinct_original_GETs':len(results),'targets':results,'new_stock_labels':0,'new_model_fits':0,'source_code_edits':0},ensure_ascii=False,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'首批原GET':'完成','新GET':len(results),'真实原文通过':sum(r.get('expected_content_seen',False) for r in results),'认证/重试/金融':0},ensure_ascii=False))
